proof: Projecting onto a proper $k$-coordinate subset gives the empty trace (from any omitted singleton) and the $k$ projected singletons, whose $1$-inclusion graph is a $k$-leaf star.  To retain an empty trace one must have $k<n$, so the largest such degree is $n-1$.  The full-domain projection has no edges.
name: Projected Maximal Degree of Singletons
